source.title: Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy: Encore Edition
source.evidenceText: Slide 1 of 8Language, Mild Blood, Mild Suggestive Themes, Use of Alcohol, ViolenceGamesMarvel's Guardians of the Galaxy: Encore EditionReleases 11/5/26VersionNintendo Switch 2EditionDigitalSale ends: 11/5/26 at 07:59 a.m. UTCLanguage, Mild Blood, Mild Suggestive Themes, Use of Alcohol, ViolenceLoadingThe critically-acclaimed, story-driven Marvel adventure, now optimized for Nintendo Switch™ 2Fire up a wild ride across the cosmos with a fresh take on Marvel’s Guardians of the Galaxy. In this action-adventure game, you are Star-Lord leading the unpredictable Guardians from one explosion of chaos to the next. You got this. Probably.The Encore Edition is exclusive to Switch 2 and includes a new set of outfits for Star-Lord, Drax, Gamora, Rocket and Groot. Dressed in 1980s glam rock threads, the Guardians are ready to bring down the house. Literally.OPTIMIZED FOR SWITCH 2Whether you’re playing at home or taking the galaxy with you on the go, expect smooth performance, refined controls, and seamless handheld play. TAKE THE LEADBecome Star-Lord and call the shots for the Guardians in and out of battle.ALL-NEW STORYFace a cosmic threat you unleashed in this fresh take on Guardians of the Galaxy, the winner of Best Narrative at The Game Awards 2021.BECOME FAMILYTurn your band of outlaws into legendary heroes on a wild ride across space.Software description provided by the publisher.About this itemGame file size (estimated)45 GBSupported play modesTV modeTabletop modeHandheld modeNo. of playersSingle system (1)Nintendo Account family-group lendingSupportedNintendo Switch OnlineSave Data CloudPlay online, access classic NES™ and Super NES™ games, and more with a Nintendo Switch Online membership. Learn moreSystemNintendo Switch 2PublisherCDE EntertainmentDeveloperEidos-MontréalSupported languagesJapanese, French, German, Italian, Spanish, Korean, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Latin American Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Traditional Chinese, American English, PolishRelease dateNovember 5, 2026ESRB ratingLanguage, Mild Blood, Mild Suggestive Themes, Use of Alcohol, ViolenceAbout Supported FeaturesThis software supports the following features and accessories:- Surround sound (linear PCM)These features are available on compatible TVs:- HDR outputWARNING: If you have epilepsy or have had seizures or other unusual reactions to flashing lights or patterns, consult a doctor before playing video games. All users should read the Health and Safety Information available in the system settings before using this software.It's possible that information related to the game, including ratings and download size, may not be finalized at time of preorder.
